Thanks for the draft. Please find attached our redlines to the MSA and the updated order form with the capacity uplift we discussed. High-level items we care about:

- Exhibit B capacity: increase from 2.5M tokens/month to 3.1M tokens/month for Q1–Q4 of the new term.

Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — MSA + Order Form (Orchid) — legal review

Hi all,

Thanks for the packet — I reviewed Orchid's redlines and attached a response with targeted edits (see Redline_Response_LB_20261014.pdf). Summary of material points and recommended language: 

1) Data retention (Section 4.2)
- Customer asks: 7-year retention for audit logs.
- Our position: we can agree to longer audit-log retention for an additional fee and limited to logs generated by customer-specific activity (not cross-customer telemetry). Proposed clause: 
  "Redwood will retain customer-specific audit logs for a period of up to seven (7) years upon payment of the Professional Services fee set forth in the Order Form. Retention shall be limited to logs that are reasonably required for customer audits and will not include aggregated or anonymized telemetry"
- Rationale: avoids creating indefinite obligations for platform telemetry while meeting customer compliance needs.

2) Liability carveout
- Customer requested carveouts for data-protection breaches.
- We cannot accept unlimited carveouts; propose a narrow exception for willful data exfiltration by Redwood personnel and a mutual indemnity for data breaches caused by the other party. Proposed cap: higher of $1,000,000 or 3x the fees paid in preceding 12 months for data breach claims.

3) Term & Auto-renew
- Customer prefers 12-month auto-renew. Commercial can accept 12 months if revenue and discount are adjusted. Legal: auto-renew mechanics are fine; we should preserve right to revert to 24-month term for price-protected deals — handled in Order Form meta.

4) Exhibit B / Capacity scheduling
- The order form increase is straightforward; confirm if this should be an amendment to the existing order (preferred) or a standalone order. If amendment, confirm effective date and prorated billing for partial month.

Next steps:
- I can produce a tracked MSA with our suggested language by EOD Thu (10/15).
- Ben: please confirm commercial levers (discount, one-time credit, effective date) so legal can reflect amounts in the redline.

If you want me to send the mark-up directly to Orchid, I'm happy to do so once you confirm the commercial position.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Redline_Response_LB_20261014.pdf
